```{r global}
source("R/load_packages.R")
load_packages()

source("R/colors.R")
source("R/teams.R")
source("R/utils.R")

data_raw <- read.csv("data/weekly_fantasy_points.csv")
dat_s <- data_raw %>%
  mutate(Fantasy.Points = if_else(Projection==0.0 & Fantasy.Points==0.0, NA, Fantasy.Points))
```

Sidebar {.sidebar}
=====================================
```{r sidebar}
CURRENT_WEEK <- get_current_nfl_week()
all_weeks <- unique(dat_s$Week)
past_weeks <- all_weeks[all_weeks < CURRENT_WEEK]
future_weeks <- all_weeks[all_weeks >= CURRENT_WEEK]

renderText({
  paste("Current Week:", CURRENT_WEEK)
})
br()

pickerInput(
    inputId = "week", 
    label = "Week", 
    choices = list("Past weeks" = past_weeks, "Future weeks" = future_weeks),
    selected=past_weeks, 
    multiple = TRUE, 
    options = pickerOptions(
        actionsBox = TRUE, 
        size = 10, 
        selectedTextFormat = "count > 3", 
        countSelectedText = "{0} weeks selected"
    )
)

pickerInput(
    inputId = "position", 
    label = "Position", 
    choices=c(unique(dat_s$Position)), 
    selected="QB", 
    multiple=TRUE,
    options = pickerOptions(actionsBox = TRUE, size = 10)
)

pickerInput(
    inputId = "team", 
    label = "Team", 
    choices=nfl_teams_by_division,
    selected=c(unique(dat_s$Team)), 
    multiple = TRUE, 
    options = pickerOptions(
        actionsBox = TRUE, 
        size = 10, 
        selectedTextFormat = "count > 3", 
        countSelectedText = "{0} teams selected"
    )
)

pickerInput(
    inputId = "point_type",
    label = "Point Type", 
    choices = list(
        "Fantasy Points" = c("Total Points", "Average Points"),
        "Projected Points" = c("Total Projected Points", "Average Projected Points")
    ),
    options = pickerOptions(container = "body"), 
    selected = "Average Points",
)

numericInput(
    inputId = "n_players", 
    label = "Number of Players to show", 
    value = 20, 
    min = 1, 
    max = 40
)

selected_weeks <- reactive({
  str_extract_all(input$week, "\\d+")
})

n_players_selected <- reactive({
  if(is.na(input$n_players)){
      return(1)
  }
  if(input$n_players > 40){
      showNotification("The number of players must be between 1 and 40", type = "warning")
      return(40)
  }
  if(input$n_players < 1){
      showNotification("The number of players must be between 1 and 40", type = "warning")
      return(1)
  }
  return(input$n_players)
})

```

```{r data-processing}
dat <- reactive({
  dat_s %>%
    filter(Position %in% input$position) %>%
    filter(Team %in% input$team) %>%
    filter(Week %in% selected_weeks()) %>% 
    group_by(Player, Team) %>% 
    mutate("Total Points" = sum(Fantasy.Points, na.rm = TRUE),
           "Average Points" = mean(Fantasy.Points, na.rm = TRUE),
           "Total Projected Points" = sum(Projection, na.rm = TRUE),
           "Average Projected Points" = mean(Projection, na.rm = TRUE),
           projected_rest_of_season = sum(ifelse(Week >= CURRENT_WEEK, Projection, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
           sd_fantasy_points = sd(Fantasy.Points, na.rm = TRUE),
           sd_projection = sd(Projection, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(cv = sd_fantasy_points / `Average Points`) %>% 
    mutate(cv = if_else(is.infinite(cv) | is.na(cv), 0, cv)) %>%
    mutate(`Average Points` = if_else(is.infinite(`Average Points`) | is.na(`Average Points`), 0, `Average Points`)) %>%
    mutate(dependability = if_else(cv>1, 0, 1-cv))
})

dat_summary <- reactive({
  dat() %>%
      select(Player, Team, Position, `Total Points`, `Average Points`, 
             `Total Projected Points`, `Average Projected Points`, dependability) %>% 
      unique() %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      dplyr::arrange(desc(!!sym(input$point_type))) %>%
      slice(1:n_players_selected()) %>% 
      mutate(Player = reorder(Player, !!sym(input$point_type)))
})

```

### Top Fantasy Football Players

```{r}
renderPlotly({
    y_breaks <- dat_summary() %>% pull(!!sym(input$point_type)) %>% sd() %>% smart_round() %>% max(., 1)
    p <- dat_summary() %>%
        mutate(text=paste0(
            Player,"\nPosition: ", Position, "\nTeam: ", Team, 
            "\n", input$point_type, ": ", round(!!sym(input$point_type),2)
        )) %>% 
        ggplot(aes(x = Player, y = !!sym(input$point_type), fill=Team, text=text)) +
        geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
        scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
        coord_flip() +
        labs(title = "",
           x = "",
           y = "Total Points") +
        theme_light() +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none") +
        scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, breaks = get_breaks(y_breaks))
    
    ggplotly(plot_theme(p), tooltip = c("text"))
})
```

Help {data-height=35, data-width=35}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
actionBttn(inputId = "help", style="gradient", icon = icon("question"))

observeEvent(input$help, {
  sendSweetAlert(session=session, title="Dependability", text="Dependability is a measure of how consistent a player is in scoring fantasy points.\nIt is calculated as 100%-sd(score)/mean(score) using the score from the chosen weeks.\n100% dependability means the player always has the same score while 50% dependability means the player's score varies by half of the mean score.", type="info")
})
```

Dependability {data-height=800, data-width=800}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Dependability of Fantasy Football Players
```{r}
renderPlotly({
    data_dependable <- dat_summary() %>% 
        mutate(text=paste0(
            Player,"\nPosition: ", Position, "\nTeam: ", Team, 
            "\n", input$point_type, ": ", round(!!sym(input$point_type),2), 
            "\nDependability: ", round(dependability, 2)*100, "%"
        ))
    
    dashed_line <- data_dependable %>% 
        summarise(dependability = 0, points = max(!!sym(input$point_type))) %>%
        ungroup() %>% 
        rbind(data_dependable %>% 
             summarise(dependability = 1, points = min(!!sym(input$point_type))) %>%
             ungroup())
  
    y_breaks <- data_dependable %>% pull(!!sym(input$point_type)) %>% sd() %>% smart_round() %>% max(., 1)
    y_nudge <- (data_dependable %>% pull(!!sym(input$point_type)) %>% sd())/10
    
    p <- ggplot() +
        geom_point(
            data = data_dependable, 
            aes(x=dependability, y=!!sym(input$point_type), color=Team, text=text),
            size=3
        ) +
        geom_line(
            data=dashed_line, 
            linetype="dashed", 
            aes(x=dependability, y=points), 
            color="#ffffff",
        ) +
        geom_text(
            data = data_dependable, 
            aes(
                x=dependability,
                y=!!sym(input$point_type),
                label=Player, 
                color=Team, 
                text=text
            ), 
            nudge_y = y_nudge,
            size=3.5,
        ) +
        labs(title = "",
            x = "Dependability",
            y = input$point_type) +
        theme_light() +
        scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
        scale_x_continuous(breaks = get_breaks(0.1), labels = scales::percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
        scale_y_continuous(breaks = get_breaks(y_breaks)) +
        theme(legend.position = "none")
    ggplotly(plot_theme(p), tooltip = c("text"))
})
```

Values {data-height=160, data-width=160}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
player_dat <- reactive({
    return_dat <- dat_s %>% 
        filter(Opponent %in% input$team) %>%
        filter(Week %in% selected_weeks()) %>% 
        group_by(Player, Position) %>% 
        mutate("Total Points" = sum(Fantasy.Points, na.rm = TRUE),
               "Average Points" = mean(Fantasy.Points, na.rm = TRUE),
               "Total Projected Points" = sum(Projection, na.rm = TRUE),
               "Average Projected Points" = mean(Projection, na.rm = TRUE),
               projected_rest_of_season = sum(ifelse(Week >= CURRENT_WEEK, Projection, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
               sd_fantasy_points = sd(Fantasy.Points, na.rm = TRUE),
               sd_projection = sd(Projection, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
        mutate(`Average Points` = if_else(is.nan(`Average Points`), 0, `Average Points`)) %>%
        ungroup()
})

player_rank <- reactive({
    player_dat() %>%
        select(Player, Team, Position, `Total Points`, `Average Points`, 
               `Total Projected Points`, `Average Projected Points`) %>%
        unique() %>%
        group_by(Position) %>%
        mutate(rank = rank(-!!sym(input$point_type), ties.method = "min")) %>%
        ungroup()
})

player_dat_filtered <- reactive({
    player_dat() %>% 
        filter(Player == input$player) %>% 
        gather(key = "key", value = "value", Fantasy.Points, Projection) %>% 
        mutate(key = if_else(key == "Fantasy.Points", "Fantasy Points", "Projected Points")) %>% 
        left_join(colors_df %>% select(short_name, color), by=join_by(Team==short_name)) %>% 
        mutate(text = paste0(
            "Week: ", Week,
            "\n", key, ": ", value,
            "\nOpponent: ", Opponent
        ))
})

player_color <- reactive({
    if (length(player_dat_filtered() %>% pull(color)) == 0){
        return("#013369")
    }
    player_dat_filtered() %>% pull(color) %>% head(1)
})
```

### Rank Among Position
```{r}
renderValueBox({
    rank <- player_dat_filtered() %>% 
        left_join(player_rank() %>% select(Player, Team, rank), by=join_by(Player, Team)) %>% 
        pull(rank) %>% 
        head(1)
    
    player_position <- player_dat_filtered() %>% pull(Position) %>% head(1)
    
    if(nrow(player_rank()) == 0){
        rank <- 0
    }
    if(nrow(player_dat_filtered()) == 0){
        player_position <- "Position"
    }
    
    valueBox(
        value = rank,
        color = player_color(),
        icon = "fa-ranking-star",
        caption = paste0("Rank in ", input$point_type, " among ", player_position, "s")
    )
})
```

### Average Points
```{r}
renderValueBox({
    value <- player_dat_filtered() %>% 
        filter(key == "Fantasy Points") %>% 
        pull(value) %>% 
        mean(na.rm = TRUE) %>% 
        round(2)
    
    valueBox(
        value = if_else(is.na(value) | is.infinite(value), 0, value),
        color = player_color(),
        icon = "fa-football"
    )
})
```

### Most Points
```{r}
renderValueBox({
    value <- player_dat_filtered() %>% 
        filter(key == "Fantasy Points") %>% 
        pull(value) %>% 
        max(na.rm = TRUE) %>% 
        round(2)
    
    valueBox(
        value = if_else(is.na(value) | is.infinite(value), 0, value),
        color = player_color(),
        icon = "fa-trophy"
    )
})
```

### Weeks Above Projection
```{r}
renderGauge({
    points <- player_dat_filtered() %>% filter(key == "Fantasy Points") %>% pull(value)
    projection <- player_dat_filtered() %>% filter(key == "Projected Points") %>% pull(value)
    value <- sum(points > projection, na.rm = TRUE)/length(points[!is.na(points)]) %>% round(2)
    
    gauge(value = if_else(is.na(value) | is.infinite(value), 0, value)*100, 
          min = 0, 
          max = 100, 
          symbol = "%",
          sectors = gaugeSectors(
              danger = c(0, 40),
              warning = c(40, 60),
              success = c(60, 100)
          ),
    )
})
```

### Player Points per Week
```{r}
renderPlotly({
    player_color <- player_color() %>% rep(2)
    player_team <- player_dat_filtered() %>% pull(Team) %>% head(1)
    player_position <- player_dat_filtered() %>% pull(Position) %>% head(1)
    
    plot_title <- paste0(input$player, ", ", player_position, " at ", player_team)
    if(nrow(player_dat_filtered()) == 0){
        plot_title <- ""
    }
    
    
    p <- player_dat_filtered() %>% 
        ggplot() +
        geom_col(aes(x = Week, y = value, fill=key, text=text, alpha=key), position="dodge") +
        scale_fill_manual(values = player_color) +
        scale_alpha_manual(values = c(1, 0.5)) +
        scale_x_continuous(breaks = get_breaks(1)) +
        scale_y_continuous(breaks = get_breaks(5), minor_breaks = get_breaks(1)) +
        labs(
            title = plot_title,
            x = "Week",
            y = "Points"
        ) +
        theme_light() +
        theme(legend.position = "none")
    ggplotly(plot_theme(p), tooltip = c("text"))
})
```

Opponents
=====================================  

Opponent {data-height=800, data-width=800}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Points to Positions by Opponent
```{r}
renderPlotly({
    team_data <- dat() %>% 
        filter(!is.na(Opponent) & Opponent != "") %>% 
        group_by(Opponent, Week, Position) %>% 
        mutate(
            weekly_total_points = sum(Fantasy.Points, na.rm = TRUE),
            weekly_total_projected_points = sum(Projection, na.rm = TRUE),
        ) %>% 
        mutate(weekly_total_points = if_else(Week>= CURRENT_WEEK, NA, weekly_total_points)) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        group_by(Opponent, Position) %>% 
        summarise(
            "Total Points" = sum(weekly_total_points, na.rm = TRUE),
            "Average Points" = mean(weekly_total_points, na.rm = TRUE),
            "Total Projected Points" = sum(weekly_total_projected_points, na.rm = TRUE),
            "Average Projected Points" = mean(weekly_total_projected_points, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "keep"
        ) %>% 
        ungroup() %>% 
        group_by(Opponent) %>%
        mutate(total_total_points = sum(!!sym(input$point_type), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        mutate(Opponent = fct_reorder(Opponent, total_total_points, .desc = TRUE)) %>%
        mutate("text" = paste0(
            "Opponent: ", Opponent,
            "\nPosition: ", Position, 
            "\n", input$point_type, ": ", round(!!sym(input$point_type),2)
        ))
    
    x_breaks <- team_data %>% pull(!!sym(input$point_type)) %>% sd() %>% smart_round() %>% max(., 1)
    
    p <- team_data %>%
        ggplot(aes(y = Opponent, x = !!sym(input$point_type), fill=Position, text=text)) +
        geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
        scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma, breaks = get_breaks(x_breaks)) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = position_colors) +
        labs(x = input$point_type, y = "Opponent") +
        theme_light()
    
    ggplotly(plot_theme(p), tooltip = c("text"))
})
```
